trigger: UE needs to update its registration with the network due to mobility, periodic timer expiry, or disaster roaming requirements.
state: UE is registered with the network and needs to update its registration information.
causes: UE supports SNSSAI time validity information.
UE supports SNSSAI location validity information.
UE has not disabled its EUTRA capability.
UE can determine based on its implementation that there is enough time to complete the procedure before the start of the unavailability period.
expected_outcomes: UE's registration is updated with the network.
Network slicespecific authentication and authorization is performed.
UE is registered for normal service or disaster roaming service.
UE considers the previously received allowed NSSAI as valid.
error_handling: If the UE is unable to store its 5GMM and 5GSM contexts, the UE triggers the deregistration procedure.
